title: Scope Management Command Group (scope add, list)
description: Implement scope add and scope list subcommands. Adding a scope modifies the account's Scopes list in accounts.json and sets NeedsReauth=true, triggering an automatic token refresh on the next api call. Both scope commands enforce the ZohoCorp block. NOTE: scope remove is deferred to a future phase.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. All account commands, ApiClient, and auto-refresh on NeedsReauth=true are working and tested.
goal: After 'zapi-cli scope add --scope ZohoDesk.Tickets.READ', the scope is added to the target account's scopes[] in accounts.json and needs_reauth is set to true. The next api call for that account triggers an automatic token refresh.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/ScopeCommands.cs with two command classes (scope add, scope list). scope remove is deferred.

ScopeAddSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--scope")] required string Scope (req, may be comma-separated), [CommandOption("--account")] string? AccountOverride. Validate() rejects if Scope is null/empty (INVALID_ARGS).

ScopeAddCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) Resolve account name (AccountOverride ?? IAccountStore.GetDefaultAsync().Name); (2) Delegate to IAccountService.AddScopesAsync (handles ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, ZohoCorp block, dedup, NeedsReauth=true, save); (3) WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { account, scopes = updatedScopes } }).

ScopeListCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) Resolve account; (2) Delegate to IAccountService.GetScopesAsync (handles ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, ZohoCorp block); (3) WriteJson(scopes) — plain JSON array of scope strings.
Register scope add and scope list under the 'scope' branch in Program.cs CommandApp.
IAccountService: add AddScopesAsync and GetScopesAsync methods.
AccountService: implement AddScopesAsync and GetScopesAsync with ZohoCorpGuard in Core.

Unit tests: scope add adds comma-separated scopes individually; scope add deduplicates existing scopes; scope add sets NeedsReauth=true; scope list returns scopes array; scope add with ZohoCorp account → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED; scope add with missing --scope → INVALID_ARGS; scope list with nonexistent account → ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.
DEFERRED: scope remove — to be implemented in a future phase.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
scope add --scope ZohoDesk.Tickets.READ adds the scope to accounts.json and sets needs_reauth=true
scope add --scope 'ZohoDesk.Tickets.READ,ZohoDesk.Reports.READ' adds both scopes individually
scope add does not add duplicate scopes if the scope already exists
scope list --account work returns a JSON array of scope strings
scope add with a ZohoCorp-domain account → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, accounts.json unchanged
scope add/list with nonexistent account → ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
After scope add sets NeedsReauth=true, the next api call (Story 5) triggers auto-refresh (integration: end-to-end verified)
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0002 §Scope Change + Re-auth Flow for the full scope management design. The scope list/output is a plain JSON array (not wrapped in { status, data }). ZohoCorpGuard must fire in BOTH scope commands — even scope list (read-only). The comma-separated scope string in --scope should be split by comma and each part trimmed of whitespace before processing. Multiple --scope calls with the same values should be idempotent (no duplicate scopes added). scope remove is explicitly out of scope for this story.

deferredItems.rationale: Deferred to a future phase by user decision on 2026-03-19. When implemented: removing a scope should also set NeedsReauth=true (narrowing permissions requires a new token). Use IAccountService.RemoveScopesAsync following the same ZohoCorpGuard + save pattern.
